sources.title: Overfitting: L2 regularization | Machine Learning - Google Developers
sources.snippet: L2 regularization is a technique used to reduce model complexity and prevent overfitting by penalizing large weights. A regularization rate (lambda) controls the strength of regularization, with higher values leading to simpler models and lower values increasing the risk of overfitting.
